children: A proposal on the future of API3 token emissions will be submitted to the Api3 DAO, putting the token's issuance schedule before governance. Voting power is snapshotted at proposal creation, so delegation changes or new stakes made after that point will not count for this vote. Token holders who want a say in the outcome therefore need their staking and delegation positions in place before the snapshot.

The proposal makes API3's supply dynamics a governance decision rather than a fixed schedule. The snapshot mechanic can encourage staking and delegation repositioning ahead of the date, as holders consolidate voting power to influence the emissions outcome. The specifics of the proposal, including any change to issuance levels, will determine how the result affects supply.
On Friday a proposal on the future of API3 token emissions will be submitted to the DAO.
Voting power is snapshotted during proposal creation. Delegation changes or new stakes don't count for that vote.
Please adjust your delegations and stake accordingly before Friday.

title: Api3: DAO proposal on API3 token emissions goes to governance vote - 04 Sep 2026
